The '''''Jungle Racer''''' was a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] that was used by the [[Cularin Militia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

{{RPG|''[[Inside-out: Uffel's Prisoners|Uffel's Prisoners]]''}}
In about [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="20 BBY">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and the adventure ''[[Night Eyes: Night's Homecoming|Night's Homecoming]]'' established that by Year 4 of the campaign over a year had elapsed since the events of ''Philology'', ''[[Inside-out: Uffel's Prisoners|Uffel's Prisoners]]'' can therefore be dated to circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> the Cularin Militia intelligence [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Xirossk]] summoned a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] to meet with him aboard the Militia [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruiser]] [[Cularin 1 (Carrack-class)|''Cularin 1'']], and he sent the ''Jungle Racer'' to transport the agents to the vessel from [[Hedrett Public Transport Facility|Hedrett Groundport]], a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].
{{Endgame}}.

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Jungle Racer'' was created by [[Rob Edwards]] and it appears in ''[[Inside-out: Uffel's Prisoners|Uffel's Prisoners]]'', a [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|role-playing]] adventure that forms part of the [[Inside-out trilogy]] of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign. During the module, if the player characters do not have a starship of their own in which they can fly to ''Cularin 1'', Xirossk dispatches the ''Jungle Racer'' to transport them to the vessel.
